newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares seen softer, turnover still slack.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares seen softer, turnover still slack.

text.p: Chilean shares opened a shade lower and are seen remaining weak as institutional players stay on the sidelines, said traders.
"We expect very thin volume with a slight downward tilt -- a boring day," said one trader.
The only news expected in the day is the Central Bank's May inflation signal which is likely to forecast a sharp slowdown in consumer price rises, said traders.
The market consensus is that the bank will forecast a 0.3 percent rise compared with a 0.8 percent increase in May 1996.
The 40-share .IPSA index opened down 0.12 percent at 120.33 points.
